verses.text: “Listen to this, family of Jacob, you who go by the name of Israel and came from the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD's name and talk about Israel's God, but you do it without truth or righteousness.
You call yourselves people of the holy city and say you lean on Israel's God. The LORD of Armies is his name.
I announced what happened before, long before it came. I spoke and made it known. Then I acted suddenly, and it happened.
I knew how stubborn you were, with a neck like an iron tendon and a forehead like bronze.
That's why I told you way back. I showed you before it happened so you couldn't say, ‘My idol did it. My carved image and my cast image gave the orders.’
You heard me. Now look at all of it. Aren't you going to speak up about it? From now on I'm showing you new things, hidden things you've never known.
They're being created now. They aren't from long ago. You hadn't heard about them before today, so you can't say, ‘Yeah, I knew that already.’
You didn't hear it. You didn't know it. Your ear has been closed for ages. I knew how badly you'd betray me, and you've been known as a rebel since the womb.
For my name's sake I'll put off my anger. For the sake of my praise I'll hold it back so I don't cut you off.
Look, I've refined you, though it wasn't like refining silver. I chose you in the furnace of suffering.
For my own sake, for my own sake, I'll do it. Why should I let my name be dragged through the mud? I won't give my glory to someone else.
“Listen to me, Jacob, and you, Israel, the one I called. I am he. I'm the first, and I'm the last.
My hand laid the earth's foundation, and my right hand spread out the heavens. When I call them, they all stand up together.
“Everybody gather and listen! Which of them has announced these things? The one the LORD loves will carry out what he wants against Babylon, and his arm will come against the Chaldeans.
I spoke. I called him and brought him here. He'll succeed on the road he's taking.
“Come close and hear this. ‘From the beginning I haven't spoken in secret. From the moment it happened, I was there.’” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.
The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says, “I'm the LORD your God. I teach you what does you good and lead you down the road you should take.
If only you'd listened to my commands! Your peace would've flowed like a river, and your righteousness would've rolled in like waves of the sea.
Your children would've been as many as the sand, your descendants as countless as its grains. Their name would never be cut off or wiped out in front of me.”
Get out of Babylon! Run from the Chaldeans! Announce it with a shout of joy. Tell it all the way to the ends of the earth: “The LORD has bought back Jacob, his servant!”
They weren't thirsty when he led them through the deserts. He made water flow out of a rock for them. He split the rock, and the water gushed out.
“There's no peace for the wicked,” says the LORD.
